message.content:
A medium‑sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
The calorie count varies with size:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | 15–18    |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | 22–25    |
| Large (≈182 g)        | 35–40    |

These values are based on standard nutrition tables for fresh, raw tomatoes. If you’re measuring a specific variety or a processed tomato product (e.g., canned, sauce), the calorie content can differ.
